description: Block containing an editable rich-text page excerpt, rendered as a sanitized contenteditable area that commits changes on input and blur.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: Owning page block for persistence context.

parameters.name: OnContentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when edited excerpt HTML should be persisted.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Raised when the excerpt receives focus.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the excerpt is rendered without editing affordances.
